In ESO, any class can fit into any play-style you want. for instance, Me and two of my friends are all Dragonknights. I am a tanky build that doesn't do much damage but can hold a mob at bay while my other friends are damage dealers (one is a fire mage and the other is a 2-handed melee). I have a Templar friend who is usually the healer of the group, but uses a destruction staff for his second weapon and can dish out quite a bit of damage also.

If you want to be a damage dealer you can use basically any weapon style you want. Sword and shield are more of a tank set, and restoration staffs are more for healers. One of my favourite weapon style is dual swords or daggers. You could have a bow for long range, and switch to dual swords for close range.

TL;DR - bow is great for ranged physical and destruction staff for ranged magic. for close-up, dual and two-handed work well depending on your style.
